hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In a circular array network, moves to equalize values correspond to median alignment of net prefix flows.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Compute cumulative deviation of prefix sums from the target average value.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sort prefix deviations and subtract their median to establish minimal transfer cost.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minMovesToBalanceCircularArray(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    n = len(nums)
    total = sum(nums)
    if total % n != 0:
        return -1
    target = total // n
    # Cumulative flow across circular boundary
    flow = [0] * n
    cur = 0
    for i in range(n):
        cur += nums[i] - target
        flow[i] = cur
    flow.sort()
    median = flow[n // 2]
    return sum(abs(f - median) for f in flow)
```
